title: Apple focuses on speed, parental controls in software upgrades
text:
Home Technology Apple focuses on speed, parental controls in software upgrades Apple focuses on speed, parental controls in software upgrades June 5, 2018 admin Technology 0
SAN JOSE (Reuters) – Apple Inc ( AAPL.O ) on Monday unveiled software program upgrades that might let older iPhones run quicker, assist mother and father restrict their youngsters’s display time and make its Siri voice assistant work extra like a rival function from Amazon.com ( AMZN.O ).
Taken collectively, the strikes introduced at Apple’s annual Worldwide Developers Conference in San Jose amounted to specializing in reliability and catching up with some opponents.
The newest model of Apple’s working system for the iPhone and iPad, iOS 12, will make older units such because the iPhone 6 work higher.
Software chief Craig Federighi mentioned iOS 12 may perform easy duties, akin to opening apps, as much as twice as quick as its predecessor, iOS 11. The new system will work on a variety of merchandise that date again to 2013.
As the smartphone business has matured, shoppers have saved units longer. Apple confronted a backlash late final yr when it emerged that the corporate slowed down some older iPhones with flagging batteries.
Other new options embody parental controls to restrict the time youngsters spend in apps, in addition to which apps they’ll use. Earlier this yr, shareholders criticized Apple for contributing to pc overuse by youngsters. Slideshow (12 Images)
“Some apps demand more of our attention than we might realize,” Federighi mentioned.
Apple additionally rolled out group video chat periods with as much as 32 customers, placing it in direct competitors with corporations akin to Cisco Systems Inc ( CSCO.O ) and Microsoft Corp’s ( MSFT.O ) Skype.
The firm broadened the ways in which builders can work with Siri, permitting extra in-app use. Until Monday, Apple had let builders faucet Siri for voice management of solely a handful of apps akin to PayPal and Uber. Amazon, against this, has been rather more open in letting builders create customized phrases to manage apps with its Alexa assistant.
New options assist defend customers’ anonymity on-line. The firm mentioned its Safari internet browser for each Macs and iPhones will defend customers from being tracked with out their permission by web sites that use “like” or “share” buttons from social media corporations.
Apple unveiled new steps to make it laborious for advertisers to tell apart amongst customers, constructing on its effort, begun final yr, to stop such monitoring. Reporting by Stephen Nellis in San Jose; Additional reporting by Sonam Rai and Pushkala Aripaka in Bangalore; Editing by Peter Henderson and Richard Chang
